capabilities: Create symbolic links and Windows junctions to files or directories from the File Explorer context menu
Remove links without deleting their targets
Reveal a link's target in the operating system file explorer
Open a linked directory recognized as another Obsidian vault
Link separate vaults so their contents appear inside a parent vault's file tree
extras: Desktop-only (Node.js/Electron). On Windows, creating symbolic links may require Developer Mode or elevated permissions; junctions avoid this. Behaviour is tested primarily on Windows and Obsidian may fail to render links to non-Markdown files such as PDFs or images. Creating a link triggers a full app reload as a workaround for vault refresh behaviour. Filesystem links do not survive sync services and must be recreated per device. Listed in the manifest as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Easy Symlinker brings filesystem symbolic links into Obsidian's File Explorer on desktop.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to include files, folders, or whole vaults that live outside the vault on disk without copying them.
summary: Desktop tool that creates and manages operating-system symbolic links and Windows junctions to files, folders, and other vaults from the File Explorer.
